meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin, the right choice of serum depends on your primary goal: whether you want to clear **active breakouts and clogged pores** or fade **post-acne marks and control oil**.

Several high-performing, science-backed serums are easily available in India under **₹700**:

---

### Category 1: For Active Acne, Blackheads & Clogged Pores (Salicylic Acid / BHA)

Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, meaning it penetrates deep into pores to dissolve excess sebum, dead skin cells, and bacteria that cause pimples.

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹549 (often on discount for ~₹494)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20Online%20*%20Bestseller.,Acne%20Day%2BNight.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92375%25%20Off.%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
  * **Why it’s great:** It features 2% pure salicylic acid combined with centella water to soothe inflammation. It is fragrance-free, highly effective for blackheads, and regulates oil production.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20Online%20*%20Bestseller.,Acne%20Day%2BNight.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92375%25%20Off.%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
* **The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution**
  *   * **Price:** ₹600[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20Online%20*%20Bestseller.,Acne%20Day%2BNight.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92375%25%20Off.%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
  * **Why it’s great:** A globally trusted formulation that targets textural irregularities and helps clear out congested pores. It's minimalist, potent, and fits right within your budget.
* **Plum 2% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹225 to ₹300 (frequently discounted heavily)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B954.%20The%20Ordinary.%20Salicylic,Betaine%203%25%20Serum.%20%E2%82%B9349%E2%82%B927920%25%20Off.%20The%20Ordinary.)
  * **Why it’s great:** Uses encapsulated salicylic acid, which releases slowly into the skin. This minimizes irritation, making it a fantastic, budget-friendly option for beginners with sensitive acne-prone skin.

---

### Category 2: For Fading Acne Marks & Controlling Oil (Niacinamide + Zinc)

If your active breakouts are under control, but you are left with dark spots (PIH/PIE) and excess shine, Niacinamide is your best bet.

* **The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%**
  *   * **Price:** ₹600[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=Table_title%3A%20Serums%20with%20Niacinamide%20Price%20List%20Table_content%3A,Last%20Updated%3A%20August%2013%2C%202026%20%7C%20%7C)
  * **Why it’s great:** A high-strength formulation that balances sebum activity, calms redness, and visibly improves skin smoothness and clarity over a few weeks of consistent use.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use#:~:text=This%20serum%20combines%20niacinamide%20with%20zinc%20to,of%20clinical%20validation%20for%20their%20active%20formulations.)
* **Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 (often available for ~₹539)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=10%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20With%20Matmarine%20%2B,Acne%20Marks%2C%20for%20Oily%20to%20Dry%20Skin.)
  * **Why it’s great:** Formulated with aloe juice instead of plain water for extra soothing benefits. It also contains Matmarine to help reduce oiliness in humid Indian weather.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum,%E2%82%B9599%E2%82%B953910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B959.%20Plum.)
* **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 (frequently drops to ~₹527)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%20Pore%20Minimizing%20Face%20Serum,Pro%20Retinol%20Complex%2C%2015ml.%20Brightening.%20%E2%82%B9325%E2%82%B927615%25%20Off.)
  * **Why it’s great:** Blended with 2% Zinc PCA to actively suppress acne-causing bacteria and quicken the fading of stubborn post-acne dark spots.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use#:~:text=Key%20Clinical%20Benefits%3A%20Regulates%20sebum%20production%20by,of%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20and%202%25%20Zinc%20PCA.)

---

### Quick Selection Guide:

* Choose **Salicylic Acid** if you currently have active pimples, whiteheads, or bumpy skin textures.
* Choose **Niacinamide** if your skin is mostly clear of active pimples, but you want to fade dark spots and manage daytime grease.

*Note: If you are using a Salicylic Acid serum for the first time, start by applying it 2–3 times a week at night to build your skin's tolerance, and always follow up with a sunscreen during the day.*
